prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1461; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type loading. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported force of the crash. Over the course of 29 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a progressive home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical, expected course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury, showing reduced range of motion, muscle guarding, and tenderness on palpation. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissue is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At discharge, the patient was improving and was instructed to continue the home exercise program as needed.
